notes.title: Group playtest
notes.content:
Hey everyone!  We’re hosting a group playtest and need your help to fine-tune the experience! This is your chance to get an early look at the game, test the mechanics, and give feedback that will help shape the final version.

🔹 Date: March 14
🔹 Time: 7 PM EST
🔹 Where: https://discord.gg/ZZbMfbXY

🔹 Who can join? Everyone! No experience is required.

Expect fun, competition, and maybe even a few surprises. 

Sign up now and be part of the playtest team! 🕹️

See you there! 💥
